gaps.desktop: The loser's text caret in the search field is drawn about 3px too far left (x~68-72 against glyph ink ending at ~70), so it covers the right bowl of the typed 'o' and the query reads as 'tc'. The winner puts the 2px blue caret about 2px after the last glyph, so 'to' stays fully legible. Secondary: the loser's Build a Treehouse icon is a pale dashed ring, which breaks the solid progress-pie set that every other project row uses.
gaps.phone: The loser's empty-state hint 'Quickly switch lists, find to-dos, search for tags...' is washed out to about #9C9C9E on the #F9F9FB sheet (about 2.6:1, roughly 22% less ink). Its Cancel button is also a greyer #383838. The winner sets the hint at about #8D8D8F (about 3.2:1, iOS secondaryLabel), with a Quick Find placeholder around #797979 and a near-black Cancel, so the hint reads as intentional guidance and not as disabled text.

why: Layout, rhythm (38px rows) and colours are pixel-identical. Desktop comes down to the caret overlapping the typed query plus one inconsistent dashed project icon. Phone comes down to the loser's too-light hint and Cancel text.
